description: This file is a Perl module named DiffHighlight that provides functionality for highlighting diff output, particularly for visualizing line changes in version control diffs. It includes methods for handling diff lines, highlighting pairs of lines, and managing terminal color codes.

methods.name: visible_width
methods.description: Calculates the visible width of a string, excluding terminal color sequences.

methods.name: visible_substr
methods.description: Returns a substring omitting a specified number of visible characters, ignoring color sequences.

methods.name: handle_line
methods.description: Processes each line of diff input, updating internal states and output accordingly.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Flushes queued diff hunks for output.

methods.name: highlight_stdin
methods.description: Reads diff data from standard input and applies highlighting.

methods.name: color_config
methods.description: Retrieves color configuration from git or defaults.

methods.name: show_hunk
methods.description: Displays a diff hunk with optional highlighting.

methods.name: split_line
methods.description: Splits a line into tokens, separating color sequences.

methods.name: highlight_line
methods.description: Highlights a specific line segment based on theme configuration.

methods.name: is_pair_interesting
methods.description: Determines if a pair of lines warrants detailed highlighting.
